description: Take a Canadian small business website URL (and/or shop description) and produce a Victory Garden Mobilization Brief: (1) Shop Asset & Tooling Card extracted from the site, (2) Lane 1 Core Fit tenders open on CanadaBuys and Alberta APC today, (3) Lane 2 adjacent Victory Garden pivot lanes (defence, marine, Arctic logistics, critical infrastructure, energy, emergency supply) judged by TypeSafe Jev for what the shop's existing equipment and crew can pivot into, and (4) Lane 3 regulatory gates to verify plus Canadian industrial retooling support programs (PrairiesCan, BDC, ISED).
